title: Our Massey products paper has been accepted
description: José M. Moreno-Fernández and I are pleased that “Higher order Massey products for algebras over algebraic operads” has been accepted by Mathematische Zeitschrift. We connect these products to differentials in the operadic Eilenberg–Moore spectral sequence.

title: A week on reliable software in Leiden
description: I am at the Lorentz Center for Reliable Software by Construction, a workshop running from 5 to 9 October 2026.

title: A preprint on Dotsenko’s conjecture
description: I have written a preprint on Dotsenko’s conjecture, weak nilpotence and the Engel identity in commutative nonassociative algebras.

title: Talking about Fibonacci numbers in Istanbul
description: I gave a talk on integral arithmetic means of the first Fibonacci numbers at the 22nd International Conference on Fibonacci Numbers and Their Applications, held in Istanbul on 6–10 July 2026.

title: I am on the FICS 2027 program committee
description: I am serving on the program committee for the 14th International Workshop on Fixed Points in Computer Science, held in Brighton on 25–26 January 2027.

title: Massey products and obstructions in Seville
description: I was invited to speak at Higher Homotopy Algebras in Topology III in Seville. My talk surveyed Massey products and other combinatorial obstructions to quasi-isomorphism.

title: Our paper on simplicial coalgebras is published
description: “Simplicial coendomorphism operads and coalgebras” is now in the Bulletin of the Australian Mathematical Society. It constructs coendomorphism operads in simplicial sets and gives finite simplicial suspensions coherent coalgebra structures.

title: A new preprint on enriched coalgebras
description: I have posted “Enriched coalgebras are sometimes comonadic.” It introduces enriched coalgebras over operads and gives conditions for the associated endofunctor to be a comonad.

title: Central limits at PSSL 112
description: I spoke about central limits via dilated categories at the 112th Peripatetic Seminar on Sheaves and Logic in Nottingham.

title: Our preprint on central limits is out
description: Henning Basold, Chase Ford, Hao Wang and I have posted “Central limits via dilated categories.” We use dilated seminorm-enriched categories to study the classical central limit theorem and a new version for symplectic manifolds.

title: Our obstruction theory paper is published
description: “An obstruction theory for strictly commutative algebras in positive characteristic” is now in Algebraic and Geometric Topology. It introduces cotriple products and explains when an E∞-algebra is weakly equivalent to a commutative algebra.

title: An expository paper on differential graded algebras
description: “On associative and commutative differential graded algebras in positive characteristic” is out in The Mathematical Intelligencer. It explains ideas from my obstruction theory paper for a broader mathematical audience.

title: Determinant Massey products in Stockholm
description: I gave a talk on determinant Massey products in Stockholm University’s Topological Activities seminar.

title: My Fibonacci numbers paper is published
description: “On the divisibility of sums of Fibonacci numbers” has appeared in Integers. I show that, for infinitely many odd n, the sum of the first n Fibonacci numbers is divisible by n, settling a conjecture of Fatehizadeh and Yaqubi.

title: Teaching mathematical structures in computer science
description: I am lecturing and supervising tutorials for Leiden University’s third-year course Mathematical Structures in Computer Science in 2025–2026.

title: A preprint on sums of Fibonacci numbers
description: I posted “On the divisibility of sums of Fibonacci numbers” to arXiv. It shows that the sum of the first n Fibonacci numbers is divisible by n for infinitely many odd n; the paper later appeared in Integers.

title: Homotopy probability at the STyLo seminar
description: I gave three introductory talks on homotopy probability theory at Leiden’s STyLo probability seminar in March and April 2025.

title: Co-Eilenberg–Moore categories at NetTCS
description: I spoke about co-Eilenberg–Moore categories for operads at the NetTCS seminar at the University of Twente.

title: Iterated suspensions at the Leiden Theory seminar
description: I gave a talk on corecognition for iterated suspensions at Leiden University’s Theory seminar.

title: A preprint on a p-adic de Rham complex
description: I posted “A p-adic de Rham complex” to arXiv. Inspired by Sullivan’s A_PL functor, it builds a strictly commutative algebra over the p-adic numbers that computes singular cohomology. I am preparing a new version.

title: Iterated suspensions in Toulouse
description: I spoke about corecognition for iterated suspensions at the 2024 Rencontre de Topologie Algébrique in Toulouse.

title: I defended my PhD thesis
description: I defended “Higher commutativity in algebra and algebraic topology” at Université Sorbonne Paris Nord. Grégory Ginot supervised the thesis.

title: Strictly commutative algebra in Lille
description: I gave a talk on strictly commutative algebra in positive characteristic at the Séminaire Topologie at Université de Lille.

title: Strictly commutative algebra in Toulouse
description: I spoke about strictly commutative algebra in positive characteristic at the Séminaire d’Homotopie et Géométrie Algébrique in Toulouse.

title: Higher invariants at the Irish Mathematical Society meeting
description: I gave a talk on higher invariants in homotopy theory at the 37th Annual Meeting of the Irish Mathematical Society in Belfast.

title: A preprint on strict commutativity
description: I posted “An obstruction theory for strictly commutative algebras in positive characteristic” to arXiv. It introduces cotriple products and studies when higher Steenrod operations obstruct strict commutativity. The paper was published in 2026.

title: Gröbner bases at the PhD student seminar
description: I gave an introductory talk on Gröbner bases and automated theorem proving at the PhD student seminar at Université Sorbonne Paris Nord.

title: Strictly commutative algebra in Seville
description: I spoke about strictly commutative algebra in positive characteristic at the Seminar of Algebra at the University of Seville.

title: Strictly commutative algebra in Stockholm
description: I gave a talk on strictly commutative algebra in positive characteristic at Stockholm University’s Topological Activities seminar.

title: A preprint on simplicial coalgebras
description: I have written “Simplicial coendomorphism operads and coalgebras.” It uses Kan’s Ex∞ functor to build a coendomorphism operad in simplicial sets and gives simplicial suspensions coherent coalgebra structures.

title: The geometry of iterated suspensions in Lille
description: I gave a talk on the geometry of iterated suspensions at the Séminaire Topologie at Université de Lille.

title: p-adic homotopy theory in Málaga
description: I spoke about p-adic homotopy theory at a seminar at the Universidad de Málaga.

title: Our paper on pre-Lie algebras is published
description: “Three Schur functors related to pre-Lie algebras,” written with Vladimir Dotsenko, is now online with Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society. We give explicit combinatorial descriptions of three Schur functors.

title: The geometry of iterated suspensions in Paris
description: I spoke about the geometry of iterated suspensions at the algebraic topology seminar at Université Sorbonne Paris Nord.

title: A poster on iterated suspensions in Ireland
description: I presented a poster on corecognition for iterated suspensions at the 36th Meeting of the Irish Mathematical Society.

title: A poster on iterated suspensions in Lausanne
description: I presented a poster on corecognition for iterated suspensions at the Young Topologists Meeting in Lausanne.

title: Our preprint on higher-order Massey products
description: José M. Moreno-Fernández and I posted “Higher order Massey products for algebras over algebraic operads” to arXiv. We show how these products describe differentials in the operadic Eilenberg–Moore spectral sequence.

title: An introduction to ∞-categories
description: I gave an introductory talk on ∞-categories at the PhD topology seminar at Université Sorbonne Paris Nord.

title: Our preprint on iterated suspensions
description: José M. Moreno-Fernández, Felix Wierstra and I posted “A recognition principle for iterated suspensions as coalgebras over the little cubes operad” to arXiv. It gives a recognition principle using coalgebras over little disks operads.

title: I defended my master’s thesis
description: I defended “The homotopy theory of the little n-discs operad,” supervised by Felix Wierstra.

title: Our preprint on three Schur functors
description: Vladimir Dotsenko and I posted “Three Schur functors related to pre-Lie algebras” to arXiv. It later appeared in Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society.
